table_description: Employee-project-activity assignments for the SAMPLE schema. Each row is one employee working some fraction of their time on one activity of one project over a date range. The join table that ties EMPLOYEE, PROJECT, and ACT together.
use_cases: List every project an employee is working on (or has worked on)
Find all employees assigned to a given project
Roll up total person-months on a project by summing EMPTIME
Filter activity history by date range (EMSTDATE / EMENDATE)
Identify which activities (via ACTNO) make up the work on a project
data_quality_notes: Composite key is (EMPNO, PROJNO, ACTNO, EMSTDATE) — a single employee can have multiple rows on the same project/activity over different date ranges.
EMPNO is CHAR(6), PROJNO is CHAR(6), ACTNO is SMALLINT — be careful matching the types when joining.
EMPTIME is DECIMAL(5,2) representing the fraction of the employee's time (typically 0.00 to 1.00) on that activity.
EMSTDATE / EMENDATE bracket the activity; EMENDATE can be NULL for ongoing work — filter with COALESCE(EMENDATE, CURRENT DATE) when treating it as a closed interval.
Summing EMPTIME alone does not give person-months — multiply by the date-range duration if you need true effort.

table_columns.name: EMPNO
table_columns.description: Employee number. Foreign key to EMPLOYEE.EMPNO. Part of composite primary key.

table_columns.name: PROJNO
table_columns.description: Project number. Foreign key to PROJECT.PROJNO. Part of composite primary key.

table_columns.name: ACTNO
table_columns.description: Activity number. Foreign key to ACT.ACTNO. Part of composite primary key.

table_columns.name: EMPTIME
table_columns.description: Fraction of the employee's time on this activity (0.00 to 1.00 in the shipped data).

table_columns.name: EMSTDATE
table_columns.description: Start date of the employee's work on this activity. Part of composite primary key.

table_columns.name: EMENDATE
table_columns.description: End date of the employee's work on this activity. NULL for ongoing assignments.
